newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia police seize Miami-bound cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombia police seize Miami-bound cocaine.

text.p: Anti-narcotics police seized a 526 pound (239 kg) load of cocaine bound for Miami in a raid on a warehouse at Bogota international airport on Thursday, police said.

The illicit cargo was discovered in a freight container and was due to be flown to the United States on a flight later in the day. A police spokesman said the air freight company that owned the warehouse had been duped into accepting the cocaine shipment.
Police declined to reveal the name of the company or say how they were alerted to the drugs. The spokesman was unable to say where the cocaine originated.
